approach: Native Rust reimplementation with a deterministic core, checked frame by frame against the cartridge in a differential harness. No emulation at runtime: the art, maps and sound are extracted once from your own copy of the European release.
notes: All seven stages, their bosses, the ending and the loop, two players taking turns or flying at once, save states and gamepads. One hit kills by default, like the cartridge; stage 5 runs without the cartridge's slowdown. An options menu adds ship hits (1 to 99, or Invincible), the starting stage (1 to 7) and the original stage 5 slowdown. Downloads ship no game material: on first run the game asks for your Gradius (E) ROM and builds its data locally.
